blockers.detail: EP4 candidates describe subject-centric address motifs. Every population contains subjects outside the two-operation cohort, so passing any payload unchanged to F5 would fail CANDIDATE_POPULATION_OUTSIDE_COHORT.

The retained runtime supplies behaviour measurements and topology, but no qualified mapping assigns EB0.4C primary role, edge, mechanism, temporal, completeness, or conflict vocabulary. Manufacturing these fields would violate PSI0G's unchanged-evidence rule.
The retained EP4 store contains 14,297 candidates; F13 accepts at most 5,000. Automatic selection or truncation has no qualified evidential semantics.
No operation-level candidate exists for a reviewer to mark PROPOSED or SUPPORTED. EP4 RECURRING_PATTERN lifecycle cannot substitute for disposition.

smallest_next_programme.name: EP3-to-EB0.4C real projection semantic review
required_decisions: Define the evidence-backed operation-level primary-role vocabulary for watchtower and three_sw2.
Define exact mappings from retained topology edges and behaviour measurements to EB0.4C edge, mechanism, and temporal features.
Define completeness and conflict semantics without treating absent observations as negative evidence.
Define how subject-level EP4 motifs may support one operation-level review candidate without automatic family membership.
smallest_next_programme.implementable_after_review: A pure deterministic adapter and one non-authoritative operation-level review-candidate manifest can then be fixture-qualified and applied to the retained B2 bundle.
smallest_next_programme.not_authorized_by_implementation_series: The semantic choices themselves and the subsequent PROPOSED/SUPPORTED disposition require recorded human review; code cannot supply them.
smallest_next_programme.still_forbidden: No disposition, F13 export, PSI0F publication, monitoring, deployment, or activation.

terminal_statement: HOLD. Real EP3/EP4 capture is now complete, but the retained payloads cannot populate F5 unchanged: EP4 candidates are address-level rather than operation-level, and the EB0.4C semantic projection has never been defined. This is the first genuine human semantic-review boundary.
